next.reason: §2023:15.99.3 RV1 keeps the 1985 21-position layout. Saying Coordinated Universal Time where 1985 said Greenwich Mean Time, and 'numeric characters' where it said 'digits', changes only the terms. The only new case is seconds '00 through nn' 'when a LEAP-SECOND directive with the ON phrase is in effect'. A 1985 program has no such directive, and §2023:7.3.17.4 GR1 says 'If the LEAP-SECOND directive is not specified, a LEAP-SECOND directive with the OFF phrase is implied'. Under OFF the range is '00 through 59', and §2023:7.3.17.4 GR3 says 'a value greater than 59 shall not be reported'. That is the 1985 range, so the result is the same. The earlier CHANGED records missed the implied-OFF default.
